title: fix(fields): a user field's person object is always sys_user (user cell and picker)
body:
Fixes #25937

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

A `user` field's person object is now always `sys_user` in the console, matching the spec contract from #24952 (PR #25074): `FieldSchema` refuses a `user` field whose `reference` names any object but `sys_user`, and `referenceTargetOf` resolves every `user` field to `sys_user` whatever the field carries.

- `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `UserCellRenderer`: the read gate's object was `field.reference || 'sys_user'`. It is now the constant `'sys_user'`, and the renderer no longer reads `field` at all. The JSDoc is rewritten: it said the person's object is "the field's `reference`".
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/UserField.tsx`: the picker's target was `meta?.reference || 'sys_user'`. It is now `'sys_user'`, with the comment rewritten to match.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/userCell.readGate-10535.test.tsx`: the `crm_member` case flips. A `{ type: 'user', reference: 'crm_member' }` field is now gated by the `sys_user` policy, and its drawing is byte-equal to a plain `{ type: 'user' }` field under the same policy. A `crm_member` policy no longer reaches it. The header bullet and the test title no longer say the person's object is the field's `reference`. The retired `reference_to` case is unchanged and still passes.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, because `ui/packages/fields/src` is a registry source the record digests.
- `.changeset/25937-user-cell-sys-user.md`: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

The route is the type's constant, not a call to `referenceTargetOf`. That helper reads the field's reference carrier first and throws when the carrier is unreadable (`referenceCarrierOf`), so it does not belong in a render path. objectui also does not import the spec's field helpers.

## Behaviour change to note: which policy gates a stored foreign `reference`

The renderer read gate (`withoutDeniedFields`) is keyed by object name. A stored object saved before the spec refusal can still carry a `user` field with a foreign `reference`, for example `crm_member`. The cell used to gate that field by the `crm_member` policy. It now gates it by the **`sys_user` policy**. That is the object the runtime expands the field into (`referenceTargetOf`), so the cell now hides exactly what the served row's own object denies. The picker also searches `sys_user` for such a field now, not the foreign object. This is the card's intent: a link to another object is a `lookup`.

- Ablation, one leg, with the fix committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old read back in place of `const personObject = 'sys_user';`, that is `field.reference || 'sys_user'`. The tool reported the anchor going 1 to 0 and the blob going `2ac4abd3f41c` to `644362b7ff75`. Result: `userCell.readGate-10535.test.tsx` **1 failed | 6 passed**. The flipped case failed at `:164`: `expected … not to contain 'Amy Lin'`, because the `crm_member` field was no longer gated by the `sys_user` policy. On restore, the blob was back to the HEAD blob `2ac4abd3f41c` and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The green leg at the same head: 7 of 7 passed.
- The test imports `../index` (source), so the ablation needs no `dist/` rebuild.

## Acceptance notes

- `LookupCellRenderer`'s comment in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` still lists `UserField` among the readers that read `reference`. That is now stale, because `UserField` fixes the target. The comment sits outside this card's declared file region (`UserCellRenderer` only), so this PR leaves it alone. Carrier: none.
- `RecordMetaFooter`'s `UserRef` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail`) still builds `reference: fieldDef?.reference || 'sys_user'` for audit fields. When the field is typed `user`, the cell renderer now ignores that `reference`, so nothing visible changes. Observation only.
